description: Permanently delete a record by sobject + id. This is a destructive write action taking an EXPLICIT target — sobject and id are required and there is no bulk form.
embedding_description: Delete a single Salesforce record by its object type and id (e.g. remove a Contact or Opportunity). Record deletion is an acceptable-loss class on this connector, unlike database destruction elsewhere in the platform — still a real destructive write, use deliberately. Requires sobject and id.

result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the deletion; low sensitivity (flag only, data_sensitivity 0.0).

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params: missing sobject or id. sf.not_found: no record with that id exists. sf.permission_denied: the CLI's authenticated user cannot delete this record.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: sf.not_found: verify the id and sobject via soql_query or get_record before retrying. sf.permission_denied: ask the operator to check delete permission for this object.
